text:
中儿童用法用量标注率低、药物相互作用及禁忌缺失情况严重、儿童用药项标注的内容前后不一致导致患者不易合理使用。建议详细标注儿童用药内容、药物相互作用及禁忌、规范药品说明书的修订，提高中成药说明书的安全性、有效性和指导性，保障儿童安全合理用药。
Analysis of labeling of children's medication and drug interaction in Chinese patent medicine instructions in outpatient pharmacy of our hospital XU Hui-fang .Zhuhai Maternal and Child Health Hospital. Zhuhai， Guangdong 519000， China.【Abstract】Objective Statistical analysis of the labeling of children's drug use and drug interaction in the instructions of Chinese patent medicines in the outpatient pharmacy of our hospital， and make recommendations. Methods Fifty-eight Specifications of Chinese patent medicines currently in use in the outpatient pharmacy of our hospital were collected. The labeling of children's medication， precautions for children， dosage and drug interaction in drug instructions were counted. And according to oral， topical， injection and other contents of the summary analysis. Results Of the 58 drug instructions， 50 were taken orally， 6 were for external use and 2 were for injection. The labeling rates of oral drugs for children， precautions for children， dosage for children （including children's discretion） and drug interaction were 14.00%， 46.00%， 22.00% and 34.00% respectively. The labeling rates of drugs for external use were 33.33%， 33.33%， 0.00% and 16.67% respectively. The labeling rates of injectable drugs were 50.00%， 50.00%， 0.00%，0.00%. There were 11 （18.96%） with definite dosage for children's use. Usage： 7 （12.07%） were related to children. Children were reminded to use them under the supervision of doctors/adults in 12 cases （20.69%）. Nine （15.51%） of the children's drug use were not clear and their safety had not yet been established. One of them （1.72%） suggested that children should be cautious and forbidden to use. 32 （55.17%） did not include any indication of medication for children. 22 （37.93%） were kept out of reach of children. 21 （63.79%） without a notice to children. Conclusion The low labeling rate of children's usage and dosage in the instructions of Chinese patent medicines in our hospital， the lack of drug interaction and contraindication， the unclear content of the label of children's medication makes it difficult for patients to understand. It is suggested that the contents of children's medication， drug interactions and taboos should be marked in detail， and the revision of drug instructions should be standardized to improve the safety， effectiveness and guidance of Chinese patent medicine instructions， so as to ensure the safe and rational drug use in children.儿童由于处于生长发育的过程当中，肝脏和肾脏等其他脏器相对于成人是比较薄弱的，选择用药时需要考虑对肝脏和肾脏的影响，儿童用药不是成人的缩小版，需根据患儿的具体病情、病因以及症状来对症用药；药品说明书是载明药品的重要信息的法律文件，是医师选用药品、药师审核处方、患者了解药品的重要途径[1]。药品说明书中儿童用药内容，对指导儿童安全、科学用药起至关重要的作用。近年来药品说明书的质量相较从前有了显著提高，但随着中药安全事件的出现、中药风险管理的开展，中成药说明书对合理用药所发挥的指导作用越来越受到关注 [2] 。
